cohort: 171 women with low-lying placenta who gave birth after 35 weeks of gestation at six tertiary maternity hospitals in France between 2007 and 2012
finding: Trial of labor was not significantly associated with a higher rate of severe PPH in women with low-lying placenta after 35 weeks of gestation and an internal os distance of 11-20 mm.
mod_finding: While an internal os distance of 1-10 mm reduced the likelihood of vaginal birth compared with 11-20 mm, it did not increase the incidence of severe PPH or severe maternal morbidity.
